content:
sam: main pipeline turned red immediately after that small merge, seeing failures in the smoke/gpu allocation stage. pinging for first eyes. logs: https://ci.internal/red/1761234567 :exclamation:

ci-bot: BUILD #4829 status: FAILED (post-merge). failed step: smoke-gpu-alloc (shard 2). exit code 137. artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/4829

olivia: ugh. which commit?

sam: commit 9f7a2b1 (PR #2318) — quick change to allocator init order. not huge but touching kv alloc path.

ashwin: I can grab first responder. planning to rerun the specific job first to see if flake. sam can you /ci rerun smoke-gpu-alloc shard=2?

sam: done: `/ci rerun job=smoke-gpu-alloc shard=2`

devops-bot: Job rerun triggered: https://ci.internal/build/4829/retry-1 (queued)

maria: if rerun fails, we should bisect between previous green (4827) and this merge. I can start a quick git-bisect on the integration matrix.

ashwin: good plan. also grabbing logs now — looks like OOM-ish allocation spike just before the crash. piping relevant section: 
```
[2026-03-18T21:14:22Z] gpu0: kvalloc: reserve 524288KB -> fail
[2026-03-18T21:14:22Z] smoke-gpu-alloc: terminated by signal 9
```

olivia: hmmm allocator init order could expose a race. if rerun passes, mark flaky and we'll open follow-up. if fails consistently, revert PR or hotfix.

devops-bot: Rerun completed: FAILED (same step). logs: https://ci.internal/build/4829/retry-1/logs/smoke-gpu-alloc

ashwin: taking it. starting bisect job now, will post intermediate results. tagging @oncall-eng in case we need infra escalation. :calling: 

maria: thanks. also adding a temporary canary gate to block auto-merge for allocator-related files until we have root cause.

sam: thx team. ashwin — if you want I can revert PR to buy time, otherwise leave with you. :thumbsup:

ashwin: hold off for 10–15m while bisect runs. if bisect points to 9f7a2b1 I'll open the revert and a minimal fix PR.

maria: noting action items: 1) ashwin bisect + update thread; 2) sam standby to revert; 3) olivia to prepare smaller repro test for allocator init race.

sam: copying results to the incident tracker if it turns into a rollback.

ci-bot: bisect job started: https://ci.internal/bisect/1761234567 (ETA ~12m)

ashwin: ok landing to triage, will post back with outcome.
